62601.description:
For centuries, the deadly arts have been perfected by those known as the Masters. Among them, the Poison Masters of the Five Great Families hold the most fearsome power and influence. Hikaru Gero, heir to the Poison Masters’ Gero Family, has lived his entire life in the underworld, far removed from love or marriage. But when the Gero Family head decrees that Hikaru’s sister must bear an heir to preserve the bloodline—by force if necessary—Hikaru resolves to protect her at all costs. It is then that Hikaru encounters Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler who becomes the target of his latest job. Realizing that the only way of solving the family succession problem and protecting his sister is through marriage, Hikaru impulsively asks Mei for help in finding a bride.

(Source: EMOTION Label Channel)
synonyms: วิวาห์แต้มพิษ

62604.description:
Meet Takuya Seo, an otaku who sits behind the popular gals in class, Ijichi and Amane. Since they're people from different "castes," you wouldn't expect them to have much in common. But when their worlds collide over a borrowed eraser, Takuya slips up about his favorite anime, and Amane...is rather quick to correct him. She says she's not a fan, but her familiarity with the series suggests otherwise. Could she be...a fellow geek?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Gals Can't Be Kind to Otaku!?
title.native: オタクに優しいギャルはいない!?
title.romaji: Otaku ni Yasashii Gal wa Inai!?

62605.description:
Matsurika, a female officer in the Inner Palace, had a little special skill, and that was "a better memory" than others. One day, she accepted a request to become a practice partner for a marriage meeting of a certain son of a distinguished family. However, the one who appeared was the Emperor, Hakuyou, who wanted to try having a marriage meeting?! And interested in Matsurika's special skill, Hakuyou even said, "For now, go and pass the civil exam"...?!

A Chinese-style Cinderella story between an emperor and a girl!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

62606.description:
Keiko Sahara, an office worker whose hobby is designing cute gel nails, is sent to a world where people's magic abilities come from their nail art. After a magic nail artist notices her ability, she becomes his apprentice!

(Source: TOKYOPOP)
synonyms: Apprentice Nail Artist in a Foreign Land

62607.description: Music video for the song Ottamagettan by ROF-MAO that was featured on NHK's Minna no Uta program.

62608.description: Music video for the song Kakurenbo no Tatsujin by Kaonashi Hasegawa that was featured on NHK's Minna no Uta program.

62613.description:
Welcome to Kindergarten Noir, an exclusive school catering to children of the global elite. Rita, one of the teachers, has been on the hunt for a boyfriend but has had absolutely zero luck so far. One day, an assassin comes after one of the children...and he’s totally dreamy?! Dive into this action-packed rom-com as it unfolds inside the world’s “safest” kindergarten!

(Source: MANGA PLUS)

62615.description:
Misaki has often felt the urge to break free from everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere far away. Even though she doesn’t yet know what she wants to become, she longs to find something she can truly be passionate about.

At the start of a new chapter on a lively campus, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Research Club—known as the “Tetsuryo Club.” As her world unfolds along the railway lines, Misaki’s heart begins to race with excitement!

As TETSUDOU MUSUME celebrates its 20th anniversary, the Tetsuryo Club sets off on a journey through the world where the Railway Girls work, in search of moments of wonder.

(Source: Pony Canyon Anime)

title.native: てつりょー！meet with 鉄道むすめ

62617.description:
Luck, an S-rank mage in the hero’s party, makes a last stand against the Demon King to save his companions. When he finally returns victorious, ten years have passed, and the world praises him as a legendary hero who died in battle. Unable to reclaim his former life, Luck conceals his identity and begins again as “Lock,” an F-rank adventurer forging a future in a world that moved on without him.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

62618.description: 15 years ago, an eerie catastrophe struck Luofeng City, reducing it to a lifeless ruin overnight. Ding Xiao—once hailed as a prodigy for forming his spirit embryo at the age of seven—joined the Spirit Suppression Sect, only to fall from grace after shattering his own embryo. Cast out, he was forced to serve as a coffin bearer in the Guibu Division, enduring five long years of hardship and scorn. Against all odds, he awakened his power anew, stunning everyone during the Sect's advancement trials and rising as a force to be reckoned with—a growing threat to the Lingbu Division. Nowadays, as sinister omens spread and supernatural threats loomed, Ding Xiao embarked on a perilous quest to save his ailing sister. But the path ahead drew him into a web of power struggles and hidden truths. As the tragedy of Luofeng City gradually came to light, he discovered that his fate was bound inseparably to the destiny of the spirits themselves.....
synonyms: ลิขิตสวรรค์

62643.description:
The anime centers on sea otter brothers Anira and Kokora, who live at a certain aquarium. Anira is the older brother who is cool, but also has a naive side. The younger brother Kokora is a passionate otter who adores his older brother.

(Source: Anime News Network)

62649.description:
Akina and his friends, having strayed into the Fantasma, find their path blocked by "Fantôme Fighters". The only ones who can stand against them are the special "Mythisch Fighters" chosen by the cards.

What is a Fantôme Fighter— The collective name for those who confront reality and fight to protect the fabricated.

What is a Mythisch Fighter— The collective name for those who withstand the Fantôme and fight to protect the real. Will the parallactic be erased, or will it become the verity? —Stand up and fight with your existence on the line.

(Source: Official Site)

62654.description: On the way to an important gathering by train, the Princess Teeniepings suddenly disappeared without a trace! To make matters even more mysterious, a Legend Teenieping appears in a mirror before Romi. Together with the new Royal Teeniepings, a grand mission begins to catch the Princess Teeniepings!

62658.description: The anime is based on temp agency Improve's mascot Inpuru-kun. It centers on Inpuru-kun taking on absurd temp jobs.

62659.description:
The scientist Chu Feng accidentally obtained the “Jin Wuling” that turned into a meteorite and fell. In order to explore its origin, Chu Feng created a supercomputer “Qiyuan”. With Qiyuan's help, Chu Feng learned that Jin Wuling actually came from a place called Wuhun. The mysterious world of the continent Chu Feng also inadvertently inspired Jin Wuling's power to be transported to Wuhun Continent. In the "Wuhun Continent", Chu Feng rescued Su Manqing, the third young lady of the Su family, but thus became enmity with the Nangong and Lu clans.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)

title.native: どこでもマキバオー ～ワールドツアー～

62676.description:
The stage moves from the Mysterious Amusement Park to the "Strange Paradise," where our friends from season 1, PetitCure Mofurun and PetitCure Pollun, will meet new allies like PetitCure Niko and PetitCure Candy!

In a Strange Paradise entirely made up of sweets, everyone goes on a candy-eating spree!? Many more heartwarming and cute PetitCure stories that'll make you smile and feel all warm inside await ♡

(Source: Official Website News, translated, edited)

62681.description:
All things possess a spirit, and the power of nature coalesced into various conscious fairies. However, due to humanity's neglect of nature and the awakening of suppressed powers, the fairies have been harmed. A human girl encounters a fairy from the depths of the water and they have known each other for many years. However, they cannot overcome the barrier between celestial and mortal. On a wondrous journey, the girl resolves to find her own power. She believes that humanity is also part of nature, and that there must be a way for humans and nature to coexist harmoniously. Can she protect nature?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Di Ling Ai: Mo Shui Linglong

62683.description:
The horror comedy manga begins one fateful day when the cowardly (unnamed) protagonist meets Mechako, the leader of the "Kaikigumi" organization which is in charge of the ghosts and supernatural creatures scaring humans. The protagonist somehow takes part in the revival of the Kaikigumi, after which one bizarre (yet not scary) phenomenon after another crops up around him.

(Source: ANN)
synonyms: ไปกันเถอะ ไคคิกุมิ

62685.description:
Fate had never been kind to Ji Ning. Wracked by illnesses and infirm his entire life on Earth, Ning knew early on that he would die as a teenager. What he didn’t know was that there really was such a thing as life after death, and that the universe was a far larger place than he thought. A lucky twist of fate (one of the few in Ning’s life) meant that Ning was reborn into a world of Immortals and monsters, of Ki Refiners and powerful Fiendgods, a world where Dynasties lasted for millions of years. A world which is both greater and yet also smaller than he ever could imagine. He would have the opportunity to join them, and in this life, Ning swore to himself, he would never let himself be weak again! The Era he was born into was a Desolate one, but Ning would make it his era.

(Source: Novel Update)

62689.description:
A salaryman who was fired from his job and has no girlfriend is caught by some gals! He is treated like a molester just for looking at them, and the gals force their way into his house, demanding that he let them stay there, and have sex with him to kill time! This man, who has no experience with women, is toyed with by the gals who know no shyness! Whether in the living room, the bath, or in bed, the girls' "inspection" never stops!

62690.description:
Maejiri, an otherwise ordinary office worker whose only unusual trait is that his butt is in the front, secretly lives a double life as the city's protector — Oshirimae Man. One day he discovers that a strange drug is spreading through the city which causes people's butts to move to the front. After infiltrating a pharmaceutical company, he uncovers the shocking "Oshirimae Man Empire Revival Plan," led by a mysterious villain burning with vengeance.

Can Oshirimae Man stop him before all of humanity finds its butt… in the front?

(Source: YouTube, edited)

62696.description:
The ultimate police duo is here to keep the peace! Rookie officer Nao just joined the force. She’s got a black belt in judo and earned the nickname “Gorilla” for her insane strength. Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. Now, these two are taking on crime together in Chinjuku.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
